title: parseLibtest drops #[should_panic] tests (failures go unreported)
property: every 'test <name> ... <result>' line of libtest output yields one entry with the matching outcome
property_test: parseLibtest reports every test line with outcome
input:
running 1 test
test tests::it_panics - should panic ... FAILED

failures:

---- tests::it_panics stdout ----
note: test did not panic as expected

failures:
    tests::it_panics
actual: empty list: the line is not matched, so the failure is silently lost
evidence: libtest's pretty format prints '<name> - should panic' for #[should_panic] tests; the line regex /^test (\S+) \.\.\. / requires a single non-space token before '...'. The function is the parser of cargo test output used by rust.runTests.
